metadata.title: The Prenup I Signed Twice
metadata.subtitle: In my first life, I signed his "standard" prenup and woke up broke in a charity ward while my best friend wore my diamonds. Now it’s 9:00 AM on signing day.

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · You wake up in the marble conference room of Cole Tower. The ink on the prenup is still wet—except you haven’t signed it yet.
Babe, just initial page 7. My lawyers kept it super simple so we can make our 11 AM flight to Como.
Simple? Page 7 assigns 100% of my fragrance brand’s IP to your holding company.
Damien, did she sign yet? The Paris buyer is waiting on our confirmation!

nodes.transcript: [whispered via earpiece] "Casey, I’m in the lobby with the real IP valuation. Do NOT sign a single line until I walk in."

nodes.prompt: Damien taps the signature line impatiently:

options.label: Flip to page 7 & circle the IP theft clause
options.player_reply_text: Explain Clause 7.4, Damien. Why does my company become yours if you cheat?

nodes.text: Damien’s smile freezes. His lawyer coughs nervously and reaches for the folder.
That’s—that’s a clerical typo! Let my assistant reprint page 7!
You slide Elena’s identical-looking counter-prenup across—with a $50M infidelity penalty wired straight to you.
Perfect—I’ll sign my half right now so we don’t miss the jet!
The glass doors slide open. Attorney Elena Park strides in with two forensic auditors behind her.
Casey, why did you bring a corporate shark to our happy morning?!

nodes.headline: Read The Fine Print
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Stolen Formula — You remember how Sienna launched a "rival" luxury perfume two weeks after your first wedding—using your secret formula..

nodes.text: 9:25 AM · You remember how Sienna launched a "rival" luxury perfume two weeks after your first wedding—using your secret formula.
Casey, look at the patent filing Sienna submitted yesterday under Damien’s shell LLC.
She stole the lab notebook from my studio safe last night.
Damien, tell the patent clerk to expedite the trademark before Casey checks the registry!

nodes.transcript: [crisp voice] "Good news: your timestamped blockchain lab log predates her filing by 11 months. We can freeze her launch today."

nodes.caption: Trademark & IP filing comparing Sienna’s yesterday submission against your original 11-month-old patent log.

nodes.prompt: Sienna puts her arm around you like your dearest friend:

options.label: Drop the trademark filing in front of her
options.player_reply_text: Funny how your "new" perfume shares my exact jasmine ratio, Sienna.

options.label: Wait until she pays the $2M factory deposit

nodes.text: Sienna’s manicure digs into her handbag strap. Her sweet mask shatters.
I—I was developing it as a wedding surprise for you! Don’t twist this!
You smile warmly while Elena prepares the federal injunction—set to trigger the exact minute Sienna wires her non-refundable factory cash.
Awesome, I’m texting the Grasse factory to start bottling 50,000 units today!
Damien exchanges a panicked glance with Sienna across the mahogany table. Neither realizes you know every move they’ll make this week.
Fine! Keep your perfume IP. Let’s just go sign the marriage license at City Hall.

nodes.headline: The Second Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Secret Apartment — You fake a migraine to postpone City Hall.

nodes.text: 1:10 PM · You fake a migraine to postpone City Hall. Right on cue, Damien heads to Penthouse 18B—the love nest he bought with your credit line.
The private investigator confirmed Damien and Sienna just entered Penthouse 18B together.
Let’s cancel the credit line that pays their concierge—right while they’re upstairs.
Sienna, why did my black card just decline on the champagne delivery?!

nodes.transcript: [panicked voice note] "Damien, the building manager just locked our elevator fob—he says the leaseholder reported unauthorized occupants!"

nodes.prompt: The building concierge calls asking how to handle the occupants of 18B:

options.label: Order security to escort them out in robes
options.player_reply_text: I’m the leaseholder. Please clear Penthouse 18B immediately and box their items.

options.label: Send the wedding photographer to the lobby

nodes.text: Ten minutes later, Damien and Sienna are marched into the lobby holding mismatched shoes.
Casey! Have you lost your mind?! We were reviewing wedding seating!
The society photographer you hired snaps twenty razor-sharp frames as they stumble out of the service elevator.
Delete those photos!! Who sent press to a private residence?!
Damien’s phone explodes with notifications from his own investors asking why his fiancée’s best friend is wearing his bathrobe.
You’re cruel, Casey! Damien only came to me because you’re cold and obsessed with work!

nodes.headline: Caught In Daylight
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Charity Gala — Damien tries to salvage his reputation at the Autumn Charity Gala—where he plans to announce a merger using your brand as collateral..

nodes.text: 7:40 PM · Damien tries to salvage his reputation at the Autumn Charity Gala—where he plans to announce a merger using your brand as collateral.
If you walk into this gala tonight, smile for the cameras. My merger closes at 9 PM.
Oh, I’m definitely coming. And I’m bringing the bank’s merger chief.
Tell the PR desk to keep Casey away from Chairman Wu!

nodes.transcript: [upbeat whisper] "Chairman Wu just read our IP ownership proof. He’s furious Damien pledged a brand he doesn’t even own."

nodes.prompt: Damien steps onto the gala stage to toast the "merged empire":

options.label: Walk onstage & announce the wedding is off
options.player_reply_text: Before everyone drinks—my brand isn’t merging with Cole Group, and I’m not marrying Damien.

options.label: Let Chairman Wu pull the funding live

nodes.text: Champagne flutes freeze mid-air. Reporters sprint to the front of the stage.
She’s joking—we had a small lover’s quarrel! Cut the music back on!
Chairman Wu takes the second mic and announces Cole Group’s $40M credit facility is suspended for fraud.
Chairman Wu, wait—we can fix the paperwork tonight!!
Cole Group’s after-hours stock plunges 19% in six minutes flat.
Damien, the Grasse factory just froze my perfume order because of Casey’s court injunction!

nodes.headline: Two Empires Shattered
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Missing Diamonds — Remember the charity ward from your first life? Sienna was wearing your mother’s diamond choker.

nodes.text: 10:15 PM · Remember the charity ward from your first life? Sienna was wearing your mother’s diamond choker. Tonight, she tries to pawn it for bail cash.
The luxury broker on 5th Street just flagged a diamond choker matching your mother’s insurance serial.
Sienna stole it from my dressing room while pretending to help me pack.
Cash only, no receipt! Just give me $80K right now!

nodes.transcript: [calm voice] "Police are already parked outside the broker’s shop. They’re waiting for your theft report confirmation."

nodes.prompt: You arrive at the pawn broker’s glass door:

options.label: Walk in & reclaim the choker face-to-face
options.player_reply_text: That choker is registered to my mother’s estate, Sienna. Put it down.

options.label: Wait outside until she signs the pawn slip

nodes.text: Sienna spins around clutching the velvet box as blue cruiser lights flash through the window.
Damien told me you gave it to him! I didn’t steal anything!!
Sienna signs the forged ownership affidavit on camera—turning a misdemeanor into a felony.
Wait—officers?! Call Damien! Tell him I’m not taking the fall alone!!
You clasp your mother’s diamonds safely into your coat pocket. In this life, nothing yours leaves your hands.
Casey, stop! If Sienna flips on me, the SEC will audit my offshore transfers!

nodes.headline: The Money Trail Opens
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Offshore Wire — Damien races to wire $6.4M from Cole Group’s escrow account to Zurich before the forensic audit locks his banking portal..

nodes.text: 8:10 AM · Damien races to wire $6.4M from Cole Group’s escrow account to Zurich before the forensic audit locks his banking portal.
Look at this screenshot from our whistleblower inside Cole Finance—Damien just triggered a $6.4M wire!
That’s the exact money he used to bankrupt my company in my first life.
Override the dual-approval alert! I’m the CEO, push the wire through!

nodes.transcript: [triumphant voice] "He didn’t know the fraud desk mirrored his terminal. The wire went straight into court escrow!"

nodes.caption: Flagged $6.4M high-risk wire — blocked and frozen inside court escrow.

nodes.text: [voice cracking in panic] "What did you do?! The $6.4M wire just froze mid-transfer—call the bank off right now before my board finds out!"
Answer me!! Why is my $6.4M wire frozen in court escrow?! Call the bank off NOW!

nodes.prompt: Damien thinks his escape fund landed safely in Zurich:

options.label: Text him the court escrow receipt
options.player_reply_text: Thanks for wiring $6.4M straight into the restitution fund, Damien.

options.label: Wait until he reaches the airport gate

nodes.text: Read receipts pop up instantly. Three frantic typing dots appear, vanish, and appear again.
HOW?! That routing number was private!! You’re a demon, Casey!!
Damien hands his passport to the VIP lounge attendant—just as border control flags his arrest warrant.
Wait—why is my passport flagged?! Casey, what did you do?!
Damien Cole’s private jet sits empty on the tarmac while his board votes to remove him as CEO.
I gave the prosecutor every text Damien sent about trapping you in that prenup. Are we even now?!

nodes.headline: We Are Never Even
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Charity Ward Ghost — Sienna begs to meet at the courthouse cafeteria.

nodes.text: 2:00 PM · Sienna begs to meet at the courthouse cafeteria. You remember her laughing beside your charity-ward bed when you couldn’t afford surgery.
Please, Casey! My mom is mortgaging her house for my bail—we were roommates in college!
You wore my dead mother’s diamonds while watching me lose everything.
If she doesn’t drop the theft charge, tell the press she bullied me for years.

nodes.transcript: [dry chuckle] "Her PR agent just forwarded us her smear-campaign draft. That’s witness intimidation."

nodes.prompt: Sienna reaches across the table with crocodile tears:

options.label: Slide her smear-campaign draft back to her
options.player_reply_text: Nice speech, Sienna. Too bad your PR firm works for my new investor.

options.label: File the civil IP lawsuit for $4M today

nodes.text: Her tears dry instantaneously. Pure venomous envy replaces the fake remorse.
You always had everything! Why couldn’t you just share Damien and the brand?!
The bailiff serves Sienna with your $4M civil IP judgment right at the cafeteria table.
Four million?! I’ll be paying you for the rest of my life!!
You stand up without finishing your coffee. Some friendships deserve to stay buried.
Chairman Wu just called—he wants to invest $25M directly into YOUR fragrance house instead of Cole Group!

nodes.headline: From Ruin To Empire
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Buyout Offer — Cole Group is bleeding cash.

nodes.text: 5:30 PM · Cole Group is bleeding cash. The emergency board puts Damien’s flagship tower up for fire-sale auction—at 40 cents on the dollar.
You’re bidding on my father’s tower?! Have you no shame, Casey?!
Relax, Damien. I’ll keep the conference room where you tried to rob me.
Tell the auctioneer to stall 24 hours—I’m begging my uncle for bridge cash!

nodes.transcript: [excited tone] "Your bid just cleared! As of 5:40 PM, Cole Tower is legally renamed under your brand!"

nodes.prompt: Reporters ask for a quote outside the tower:

options.label: Dedicate the lobby to female founders
options.player_reply_text: Never sign away your work for a ring. Build your own tower instead.

options.label: Have Damien’s brass nameplate unscrewed live

nodes.text: Your quote goes viral across every business channel within twenty minutes.
Pre-orders for your autumn perfume just sold out 80,000 bottles!
Maintenance workers unbolt "COLE GROUP" from the marble facade while Damien watches from his lawyer’s sedan.
Look at his face—he finally realizes he picked the wrong woman to betray!
The sunset reflects off the glass tower you now own outright—no prenup required.
Final pretrial conference is tomorrow morning. Ready to close the book on both of them?

nodes.headline: The Final Signature
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Unbound — The gavel falls.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · The gavel falls. Damien receives 9 years for corporate fraud; Sienna receives 4 years for grand theft and IP conspiracy.
It’s over, Casey. Every stolen dollar is returned, and your flagship boutique opens in Paris next month.
In my first life I begged for mercy in a charity ward. Today I own the whole skyline.
If I ever get out, I swear I’ll—

nodes.transcript: [laughing softly] "Chairman Wu sent a bottle of 1996 Dom Pérignon to your new penthouse office. Care to celebrate?"

nodes.prompt: You hold the unsigned copy of Damien’s original prenup:

options.label: Feed it straight into the office shredder
options.player_reply_text: Goodbye to the old me. Let’s toast to Paris.

options.label: Frame page 7 as a warning in the boardroom

nodes.text: The shredder chews the toxic clauses into confetti.
Cheers to the woman who read the fine print twice!
You hang the red-circled page 7 beside your IPO bell—a permanent reminder to never trust cheaply.
Every founder who visits this office is going to ask about that frame!
Your new perfume—named "Second Breath"—tops the global charts before dusk.
I didn’t need a richer husband. I just needed to wake up.

nodes.headline: Own Your Name · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: Your signature, your empire, your name — Damien’s nine-year sentence closes the chapter forever.
